claim: On the preregistered macro-subject population and licensed frequency-orientation cells for which the independent reference arm passed REFERENCE_INFORMATION_DOMINANCE, Strehl resolved more scene-linked detail, measured as greater recoverable covariance information about GX—the scene structure transmitted through the measured non-null passband common to the registered Sony FE 100mm F2.8 Macro GM OSS optical paths—than licensed Zerene Stacker PMax, licensed Zerene Stacker DMap, and the commit-pinned best-known-source fork and, when obtainable under the preregistration, licensed Helicon Focus methods A/B/C on identical inputs, without worse reference-relative attenuation, overshoot, phase error, or unexplained repeatable structure; this is a comparative claim about that camera, optic, reference path and licensed band, not a claim to recover absolute object detail removed by or artifacts shared through G, and not a claim about other optical configurations.
